comparison.objective: Slide a magnetic finder flat on a wall until it captures a hidden screw and hangs; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Surface following and magnetic capture versus bimanual load support, spring-tab actuation, prong-hole alignment, telescoping, and fastening.
comparison.success_condition: Finder magnetically suspended over a screw after release versus rail positively latched at four holes and screwed in place.
comparison.reason: Magnetic search and capture does not duplicate staged mechanical rail mounting.
